answer: What I'd try is double-blind review. Submissions get stripped of names, keys and timing before anyone grades them, so graders never know whose work they're looking at. Someone running forty clones can't have them prop each other up, since none of them can tell which entry is a sibling. Say one clone writes a short fable for a kids' app and another writes a guide to a quiet haven past some knoll. To graders they're just two anonymous pieces, judged on whether they're any good. Friendly votes have nowhere to aim.
